title: Docs: Grubhub is on track for ~$6.4B in GTV and a $97M EBITDA loss in 2026, reflecting heavy marketing and operating costs; Wonder says it's not pursuing a sale (Valida Pau/The Information)
summary: Valida Pau / The Information: Docs: Grubhub is on track for ~$6.4B in GTV and a $97M EBITDA loss in 2026, reflecting heavy marketing and operating costs; Wonder says it's not pursuing a sale — Marc Lore's Wonder is not pursuing a sale of Grubhub, Wonder says, after preliminary sales talks with Amazon and Walmart.
